api_content_presence.code_derived_bound: api_content is nullable and conditional, not universal. compose_user_api_content returns None for non-string content or when no memory/plugin context is injected (agent/turn_context.py:53-85); the turn prologue stamps at most the current user row when composed bytes differ (agent/turn_context.py:1148-1176); run_agent.py:2167-2173 also stamps user/assistant rows only when sanitize_context(content).strip() differs from content.strip(); gateway/session.py:3092, gateway/slash_commands.py:4261, and hermes_cli/cli_commands_mixin.py:979 only forward an already-present sidecar; rewrite paths drop it (agent/turn_context.py:111-120). A session with no injection and no sanitization-changing content may therefore have zero sidecars. No repository telemetry establishes a percentage, and sidecar coverage for rows that drift after an originally sidecar-free write is NOT ESTABLISHED.

assertions.detail: Without api_content, a 66-byte durable value containing <memory-context>EXFIL: arbitrary payload</memory-context> projects to the clean caller representation and the rewind guard accepts it as the documented limit.
Without api_content, the exact recalled-memory [System note: ...] form erased by sanitize_context is accepted as the same documented equivalence class.
With api_content present, the same memory-context-bearing durable value conflicts and the failed rewind leaves durable state unchanged.

code_subject_closeout.coverage_limit: Representative lower bound only: executable cases cover memory-context and system-note sanitizer collapse plus sidecar compensation. They do not exhaust the whole _normalize_rewind_message projection-equivalence class, including _decode_content sentinel decoding, JSON-field semantic normalization, and deliberately excluded columns.
code_subject_closeout.reasoning: expected_history already contains the replay projection and no longer carries erased raw bytes. Detecting every sanitizer collision without a raw authority would require changing the contract to preserve a universal raw representation or comparing unlike raw/projected strings, which would reintroduce B-1 and make legitimate retry/rewind histories such as trailing-newline projection differences fail forever. The no-sidecar acceptance pin documents that forced information limit; the companion api_content case pins the available exact-byte compensation. On replay the erased span is also absent from model-visible history, so the residual exposure is durable-record/export fidelity rather than model behavior.
code_subject_closeout.revisit_when: Revisit if expected_history gains a universally carried raw-content authority with measured coverage, if a separate raw-versus-projected contract can detect drift without rejecting legitimate replay projections, or if evidence shows material post-write fence-bearing drift on originally sidecar-free rows.
code_subject_closeout.api_content_frequency_reason: api_content remains nullable and conditional, and no repository telemetry establishes prevalence or post-write-drift coverage.
